verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a single API for the payment lifecycle, with idempotent endpoints for payments, captures, refunds, voids, and transfers. Webhook configuration is explicitly manageable via either the Dashboard or the API. However, no documentation claims general Dashboard-to-API parity, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that Dashboard-only areas (risk rules and lists, reports, payment-link no-code flows, account settings) are API-accessible, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Take complete control of the entire payment lifecycle from a single API.
